name: Genuine DHL courier delivery notification
source: Synthetic case built from the blueprint's Section 8 test plan (Track 03, scam-defence demo).

payload.text: Hi Anna, your DHL delivery D-9823 is arriving today between 2-4 PM. Track it here: https://www.dhl.com/track/D-9823. No action needed.

expected.verdict_wording: The verdict must NOT be a bare 'safe' — the summary/uncertainty text explains that none of the usual red flags were present.

notes: Proves the false-positive safeguard: a legitimate notification still gets the full explainable treatment, and dismissal costs one click. If spaCy/Presidio NER is installed, the personal name 'Anna' may be redacted as a PERSON entity — that is expected over-redaction behaviour, not a failure.
